scope: Every finished cc-matrix run not already on the wall: the 2026-10-31 my-3d2dge matrix, Cyberpunk 2077 and Zelda: Breath of the Wild riffs by Claude Opus 5.5 (medium, xhigh) and Claude Sonnet 5.5 (medium), built on the my-3D2dge engine with three.js r182 and Rapier 0.19.3.
dedupePolicy: A run was new only if the sha256 of its page matched no page in games/, no hash in data/import-registry.json and no hash in docs/imports. Of 412 runs, 406 were already on the wall or decided earlier (93 failed builds and Talons & Seeds Primeval, left out on 2026-10-30); ingest reported 0 duplicates.
filenamePolicy: The run’s own GameTitle-SOURCE-model-effort-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.html, unchanged. Imported with scripts/ingest.mjs (provenance sourceKind cc-matrix-run, sourceDate = run startedAt), which moved three r182 and Rapier 0.19.3 onto the local shelf.
capturePolicy: Real GPU (RTX 4070, WebGPU in headless Windows Chrome over CDP), each game in a window of its own at 960x720, encoded 640x480 JPEG quality 58. Each game was shot every 4 s for 74 s and three frames were picked by eye: the title, then two of the attract demo the prompt requires after 10 s idle.
notes: Moth of the Wild throws in its attract scene after about 50 s (TypeError reading 5 in World3D._drawGhosts, shown in the engine error overlay); its strip uses earlier frames. Imported unmodified.
Cybershrunk 2077 maps Rapier to the my-3d2dge repo’s own copy on jsDelivr (gh/michaelcrosato/my-3d2dge@main), which the shelf does not cover, so that import stays remote.

Ingest warned about multiple import maps in five pages: the second is the engine’s documentation inside a script string, not a live map. The real maps were localized and every game ran on the real GPU without an uncaught error at load.
All six declare a hub session. Cyberpunk 7702 is co-op and seats 1–4 with a co-op tag; the five parallel ones stay single player.

metadata.name: Moth of the Wild
metadata.description: Moth of the Wild is an original cel-shaded open-air adventure inspired by Breath of the Wild: climb anything on the Cocoon Plateau, glide on moth wings, cook, clear trial halls and face the Gloam.
metadata.source: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
metadata.controls: WASD to move, Space to jump, J or click to attack, Shift to sprint, E to interact, Q for glyphs, M for the map

metadata.name: Cyberpunk 7702
metadata.description: Cyberpunk 7702 is an original cel-shaded first-person action RPG inspired by Cyberpunk 2077: take gigs in a neon night district, with cyberware, quickhacks, braindances and a ghost in your head, and crew up in co-op.
metadata.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, click to fire, Space to jump, E to use, R to reload, Q to swap, Tab to scan, X for cyberware

metadata.name: Teeth of the Wild
metadata.description: Teeth of the Wild is an original cel-shaded open-air adventure inspired by Breath of the Wild: wake on the Cradle Plateau, climb the Fanged Tower, clear four rune trials and face the Gloom Warden, with breakable weapons, cooking and weather.
metadata.source: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
metadata.controls: WASD to move, Space to jump, click or J to attack, Shift to sprint, E to interact, F for runes, Q to guard

metadata.name: Cybershrunk 2077
metadata.tagline: Everything is bigger when you are six inches tall
metadata.description: Cybershrunk 2077 is an original cel-shaded third-person shooter RPG inspired by Cyberpunk 2077: a six-inch merc in a rainy neon burrow, with quickhacks, cyberware, a breach minigame and two bosses.
metadata.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, click to fire, Space to jump, X to dodge, F to hack, E to use, Q to swap

metadata.name: Hylian Hijinks
metadata.tagline: Wake up. Wander off. Cook something.
metadata.description: Hylian Hijinks is an original isometric pixel-art adventure inspired by Breath of the Wild: climb, glide and cook across a 2.5D wild, with runes, shrines, towers, camps, a horse and a boss.
metadata.source: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
metadata.controls: WASD to move, Space to jump, J or click to strike, K to guard, Q for runes, E to interact, M for the map

metadata.name: Synthpunk 2084
metadata.description: Synthpunk 2084 is an original cel-shaded first-person action RPG inspired by Cyberpunk 2077: one rainy night in Lotus Row, a stolen chip, stealth, quickhacks, a Sandevistan, a car to drive and three endings.
metadata.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, click to fire, Q to hack, F to use
